agyos_skill.intent: Azure AI VoiceLive SDK for Java. Real-time bidirectional voice conversations with AI assistants using WebSocket.
agyos_skill.instructions: Real-time, bidirectional voice conversations with AI assistants using WebSocket technology. ```xml <dependency> <groupId>com.azure</groupId> <artifactId>azure-ai-voicelive</artifactId> <version>1.0.0-beta.2</version> </dependency> ``` ```bash AZURE_VOICELIVE_ENDPOINT=https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/ AZURE_VOICELIVE_API_KEY=<your-api-key> ``` ```java import com.azure.ai.voicelive.VoiceLiveAsyncClient; import com.azure.ai.voicelive.VoiceLiveClientBuilder; import com.azure.core.credential.AzureKeyCredential; VoiceLiveAsyncClient client = new VoiceLiveClientBuilder() .endpoint(System.getenv("AZURE_VOICELIVE_ENDPOINT")) .credential(new AzureKeyCredential(System.getenv("AZURE_VOICELIVE_API_KEY"))) .buildAsyncClient(); ``` ```java import com.azure.identity.DefaultAzureCredentialBuilder; VoiceLiveAsyncClient client = new VoiceLiveClientBuilder() .endpoint(System.getenv("AZURE_VOICELIVE_ENDPOINT"))
